pinned_as2_api_source.detail: The intrinsic TextField API declares getNewTextFormat/setNewTextFormat separately from getTextFormat/setTextFormat.

bundled_usage_examples.detail: SkyUI sets a new format then assigns later text.
SkyUI saves and applies each field new format before assigning initial text.

hud_change: meter value uses setNewTextFormat before drawPercent performs later value.text assignments; title, labels and party status strings are assigned before setTextFormat.
verification: test_scaleform_contract.py checks ordering; hud_contract.js models current-text vs future-text formats and asserts the displayed percentages inherit font/size/color; compiled hudmenu.swf export contains setNewTextFormat.
limitations: Intrinsic declaration and bundled usage are source references, not a running Scaleform runtime.
